messages:
nora_csm: Quick heads-up — just finished onboarding call with Harken Health. They gave a bunch of product asks and flagged a renewal question. Notes + recording: https://docs.google.com/drive/fake-link. Can product/dev skim and help prioritize?

maria_cs: Can you paste the raw asks here so we don't lose anything from the call?

nora_csm: copying raw capture below (short):
1) Multi-tenant billing view: finance team wants a single dashboard that shows spend per-clinic and ability to export monthly CSVs.
2) Per-route snapshot sharing: they want to share a read-only snapshot of routing configs with partners.
3) API key scoping: limit keys to specific routes + per-key rate caps.
4) Embedding freshness control: option to re-index docs on demand, currently manual + confusing.
5) SLA latency dashboard: high-level latency percentiles and alerts (p95/p99 by model).
6) UX: onboarding modal keeps reappearing for some users (reported across 3 customers).

Quick capture CSV I dropped into notes:
```
customer,ask_id,short_desc,impact,requested_by
harken,HH-01,multi-tenant-billing,high,finance
harken,HH-02,share-route-snapshot,medium,ops
harken,HH-03,api-key-scoping,high,engineering
harken,HH-04,embedding-freshness,medium,content
harken,HH-05,latency-dashboard,high,prod
harken,HH-06,onboard-modal-bug,low,design
```

nora_csm: Renewal is in ~6 weeks. They said budget review hinges on having better spend visibility and a plan for SLA observability. They explicitly called out billing view and latency dashboard as deal-makers.

ryan_pm: Thanks — initial triage: billing view and SLA dashboard -> P1 (direct renewal impact). API key scoping -> P1 (security + compliance). Snapshot sharing and re-indexing -> P2. Onboarding modal -> P3.

devin_se: From infra side: billing view needs a per-tenant aggregation layer. We could prototype with a read-only export from current per-route metrics in ~2w if we limit timeframe and fields. For SLA dashboard, we already emit latencies to metrics; putting a p95/p99 view + alerting rule is ~3-5d work.

anya_research: Suggest we also capture usage signals for each ask (how many accounts hit the modal, which routes cause highest spend). I can pull sample queries for Harken to quantify impact — helps prioritization.

sam_engineer: I'll pick up the SLA dashboard spike tomorrow. Plan: 1) dashboard in Grafana (p95/p99 by model), 2) alerting to oncall channel, 3) export job for monthly CSVs. ETA for MVP dashboard: 4 business days.

nora_csm: Important: Harken wants a commitment before the renewal call. Can we scope an explicit MVP we can show them? If we can demo the CSV export + a simple p95 chart that would satisfy them for now.

ryan_pm: Agreed. MVP = export CSV (billing) + p95/p99 chart for one model + written rollout plan for API key scoping. We'll create a short customer-facing plan and timeline.

devin_se: I'll scope the minimal export schema and write a tiny job for CSV -> staging bucket. If sam can deliver the Grafana chart we can demo next Wed.

maria_cs: I've logged this into the product board as PROD-9123 and linked the Google notes. Added Harken's renewal date and priority tags.

cs_bot: Reminder: A new triage thread was created in #product-triage for PROD-9123. Meeting suggested: Wed 09:00 PT.

ryan_pm: Can @devin_se and @sam_engineer join the triage on Wed 09:00 PT? If yes I'll send calendar invite and a short agenda.

devin_se: I'll be there. :thumbsup:

sam_engineer: Confirmed. Adding a short design doc to the ticket tonight.

nora_csm: TL;DR — Harken: billing CSV + SLA chart = unblock renewal. API key scoping important for compliance. Product triage Wed 9am PT. Assign owners: sam (SLA dashboard), devin (CSV export + API key scoping scope), anya (usage signals).
